# `jouet job logs`

- **Usage:** `jouet job logs [-n --lines <N>] <ID>`

Print the end of a job's log

## Arguments
- **`<ID>`** — The job's ID

## Flags
- **`-n --lines <N>`** — Lines to print (default 50; 0 prints all of it)
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
